result.summary: Several layout and truncation issues make restaurant cards and category filters look broken or incomplete, with cut-off names and partially visible items.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off on the right edge of the Fastest near you carousel card.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size, or ensure horizontal cards fully show names with proper ellipsis or wider card layout.

issues.description: The Fastest near you horizontal list clips the third restaurant card so only part of the image and text is visible, looking broken.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent peek/padding for carousels, ensure cards don't clip mid-content, and verify scroll bounds on different screen widths.

issues.description: Category filter chips (e.g. Healthy) are cut off at the right edge with no clear affordance that the row scrolls.
issues.suggestion: Show a partial next chip or fade/scroll indicator so users know more categories are available.

issues.description: The bottom Popular right now card (pizza image with -20%) is heavily cropped by the bottom navigation, so the offer looks incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding above the tab bar so full cards (or a clear peek) remain visible when scrolling.

issues.description: Delivery fee on Green Bowl Poké shows '€0.90 delivery' while the promo banner emphasizes free deliveries, which can look inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Align fee display with active promos or clarify when free delivery applies so pricing doesn't appear wrong.
